policy: NIGHTHAWK publishes separate platform images. A single image is not expected to boot on every device; each target requires its own boot chain, kernel, device tree, firmware, drivers, and validation.

targets.name: Orange Pi Zero 3
targets.notes: Use the dedicated ARM64 Orange Pi Zero 3 image in NIGHTHAWK-OS-RELEASE Release 4. This Allwinner H618 image must not be flashed to PCs or other boards.

targets.name: Raspberry Pi family
targets.notes: Separate model-specific images and firmware are required. Do not use the Orange Pi image.

targets.name: Intel/AMD 64-bit PCs
targets.notes: A 1.63 GiB x86_64 ISO has been generated for Intel/AMD desktops and laptops. BIOS/UEFI boot, representative physical hardware, and peripheral validation remain pending; no universal compatibility claim.

targets.name: Virtual machines
targets.notes: The x86_64 PC ISO can be evaluated in a VM. Dedicated virtual-disk artifacts and named guest profiles are not yet published or fully validated.

targets.name: Other ARM64 single-board computers
targets.notes: Each board needs its own supported bootloader, kernel, device tree, firmware, and hardware validation.

targets.name: Android phones and tablets
targets.notes: Not a standard Linux PC/SBC target. Requires per-model bootloader unlock support, device trees, kernel/vendor drivers, partition and recovery compatibility. No generic Android image is promised.
